final: WITH telescope_avgs AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse FROM telescope_avgs ta, overall_avg_val oav WHERE ta.avg_pulse > oav.overall_avg), second_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_avg FROM above_overall), final_telescopes AS (SELECT ao.avg_pulse FROM above_overall ao, second_avg_val sav WHERE ao.avg_pulse > sav.second_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as final_mean_avg, AVG(avg_pulse) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_val) as above_overall_avg, AVG(avg_pulse) - (SELECT second_avg FROM second_avg_val) as above_second_avg FROM final_telescopes
